None of these candidates directly support the activity of automatically flagging travel expense reports against policy thresholds. The activity requires:
- Travel expense report monitoring and policy violation detection
- Threshold comparison logic (flight price variance, hotel vendor compliance)
- Pre-approval routing based on violations

The candidates surfaced are all procurement/vendor/material-focused resources. While the activity touches procurement peripherally (vendor lists, policy approval workflows), none of these resources actually provide travel expense management, policy enforcement, or violation flagging capabilities. They handle vendor management, material sourcing, and procurement orchestration—not travel policy compliance or expense report processing.
